findings: Full-resolution mode is used by Fill and manual zoom. Subsequent viewport scale changes retain the same render URL/pixels and never change edits, history, selection or saved revision. New-photo, memory-pressure and full-resolution failure reset Fit.

Wheel/pinch coordinates must be mapped from scene coordinates into the viewport, not interpreted in scrolled content coordinates. Consecutive pre-layout wheel events use a pending bounded transform. Full-to-full anchors are exact; Fit-to-full allows at most half a source pixel for the rounded reduced raster; 1:1 snaps to backing pixels.

Initial offscreen input tests found incorrect wheel/pinch anchors. Subsequent 1600% runs hit the unchanged five-second GUI watchdog twice; captured samples have no usable call graph. Disabling image smoothing did not fix the failure and was reverted.

Inactive Crop/Transform/Retouch/Local Canvas sizes followed the magnified image (49152 x 32768 for the 3072 x 2048 chart at DPR1). They now retain zero/tiny geometry while pixel zoom is active; tools currently force Fit. The same 1600% scenario passes with unchanged image smoothing and watchdog. Hidden Canvas dimensions are asserted.

Actual Qt events cover centered/off-center double click, wheel bursts, native-gesture pinch events, smooth horizontal/vertical/momentum pan, limits, invalid controller input and percent entry. Actual scene geometry, full CPU provider pixels and catalog/original invariants are checked.
Eight language packs add Fill. Zoom controls remain inside their pane and do not overlap at 1000 x 640 in all eight languages.

The specification retains TARGET on PRV012; an explicit implemented-target phase mapping admits only this source-completed case. Unknown/unimplemented targets remain excluded. The mapping is not a QA certification.
CI/release require four new input cases with three repetitions and retain artifacts. Existing blocking checks, watchdog limits and release gates remain required.
limits: Synthetic native-gesture delivery does not prove physical trackpad hardware behavior. Cocoa/Metal/DPR2 is claimed only for a completed separately authorized native report.
PRV011 and ZOM006–009 tool-overlay coordinates at arbitrary zoom remain unqualified; current tools use Fit. GAP049 remains open pending complete Viewer scope/native qualification.

No overall 1.0 qualification, hardware/load/real RAW/model quality/installation/update completion is inferred. Source version 0.9.0 and stable release 0.5.1 remain; no release assets or appcast published.
